items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: A bento-style feature showcase: two detail cards plus a full-width highlight row with a circular status cluster.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats Band
items.description: A horizontal strip of key metrics, divided by hairlines with a subtle accent bar above each figure.

items.name: pricing-cards
items.title: Pricing Cards
items.description: Three-tier pricing layout with a highlighted plan, feature checklist and a call-to-action button per tier.

items.name: testimonial-wall
items.title: Testimonial Wall
items.description: A responsive grid of quote cards with initials avatars, name and role — no external images required.

items.name: cta-banner
items.title: CTA Banner
items.description: A full-width call-to-action band with a soft radial backdrop, a heading, supporting copy and two buttons.

items.name: portal
items.title: Portal
items.description: Renders children into a different part of the DOM tree, mounted client-side only to avoid an SSR markup mismatch.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: An img with real loading and error states — a skeleton while it loads, a fallback panel if it fails — instead of a blank box or a broken-image icon.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A structured list of rows — plain, divided or bordered — with title/description sub-parts for real content instead of a bare ul/li.

items.name: info-label
items.title: Info Label
items.description: A form label with an inline info icon that reveals help text in a tooltip, instead of a permanent description line.

items.name: search-box
items.title: Search Box
items.description: A search field built on InputGroup — leading icon, a clear button once there's text, and an optional shortcut hint when there isn't.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A dismissible/interactive chip for one item in a set the user picked — distinct from Badge, which is a static status indicator.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping avatars with a max cutoff that collapses the rest into a single "+N" circle.

items.name: persona
items.title: Persona
items.description: An avatar paired with name, secondary text and a presence indicator — the "who is this" unit used across lists, headers and cards.

items.name: app-provider
items.title: App Provider
items.description: The one wrapper an app mounts at its root: theme, a shared tooltip provider and the toast viewport.

items.name: spin-button
items.title: Spin Button
items.description: A number field with increment/decrement steppers — arrow keys and the button pair both move by step, clamped to min/max.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: An interactive star rating input, with optional half-star clicks and keyboard-free hover feedback.

items.name: rating-display
items.title: Rating Display
items.description: A read-only rating — filled/partial/empty stars plus an optional review count — for showing an average rather than collecting one.

items.name: swatch-picker
items.title: Swatch Picker
items.description: A grid of preset color swatches on a single RadioGroup, so selection and keyboard navigation come for free.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A saturation/value area, a hue slider and a hex input kept in sync through one HSV state, built without a color-math dependency.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of grouped actions on Radix's Toolbar primitive — proper roving-tabindex keyboard navigation between buttons, links and toggle groups.

items.name: tag-picker
items.title: Tag Picker
items.description: A multi-select combobox that renders its selection as removable Tags — Popover for the surface, Command for the searchable list.

items.name: overflow
items.title: Overflow
items.description: Renders as many items as fit on one line and collapses the rest into a "+N" dropdown, measured against the real container width rather than a guessed breakpoint.

items.name: teaching-popover
items.title: Teaching Popover
items.description: A coachmark: Popover's positioning and portal behaviour plus the title/step-counter/next-prev chrome a feature walkthrough needs.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A nested expandable tree on Collapsible, with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation between rows instead of every row sitting in the tab order.
